title: Boat Park
description: Pilot nine wildly different boats through a working marina slalom, then master each vessel's momentum to dock safely.

prompt.objective: Build a marina game where nine boats run a buoy slalom and dock with distinct momentum.

mintAssets.brief: Nine vessels plus docks, buoys, hazards, and wildlife.
Harbor, engine, water, collision, checkpoint, docking, and wildlife cues.

experience: Steer, boost, and reverse through a slalom before approaching the assigned berth.
Learn nine boats, from a dinghy and speedboat to a cruise liner and aircraft carrier.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright stylized marina water, readable navigation markers, oversized vessel silhouettes, and a crisp nautical HUD.

thumbnail.alt: A boat navigating bright marina water between docks and course markers.

social.title: Boat Park
social.description: Master nine boats, clear the marina slalom, and dock without scraping the hull.

image.alt: A boat navigating bright marina water between docks and course markers.
